notes.title: MotionRec to be Released in 2025!
notes.content:
PLAYISM is proud to announce that we will be publishing MotionRec, the recording puzzle action game by HANDSUM, and that it's slated for a Steam release in 2025!

[previewyoutube=fOFq4tvtHRI;full][/previewyoutube]
We also have a new trailer to introduce the game, so please check it out!

With the power to record and play back your actions, Rec will explore a desolate world while solving puzzles to proceed. Please wishlist the game and look forward to further announcements!

What's more, MotionRec will have a playable demo to be shown at PAX East in Boston from May 8 to May 11. We'll also be giving out free casette tape-shaped acrylic key chains to anyone who plays the demo at the PLAYISM booth, so please stop by if you have the chance!

Please also check out the game's new PLAYISM page!
